operational_scope: Active ship inventory; readiness and deployment status are not implied.
source_reference: “U.S. Navy Active Ship Force Levels, 2000–2006,” row dated 9/30/01
source_note: The NHHC table records 12 carriers on 2001-09-30. The FY 2001 Department of the Navy budget independently provides for 12 aircraft carriers and states that USS John F. Kennedy transferred from reserve to active force during FY 2001.

operational_scope: Active SSBN inventory; deployed patrol count and readiness status are not implied.
source_reference: “U.S. Navy Active Ship Force Levels, 2000–2006,” SSBN row dated 9/30/01
source_note: The NHHC table records 18 SSBNs on 2001-09-30. The FY 2001 Department of the Navy budget independently provides for 18 ballistic missile submarines.

operational_scope: In-service fleet inventory as of the report date; the source estimates 60% availability, so this is not a continuously deployable count.
source_reference: Avis n° 90 (2001–2002), tome VIII, “Projet de loi de finances pour 2002 : Défense – Marine,” deposited 2001-11-22, section I.B
source_note: The report explicitly calls Charles de Gaulle the sole carrier in service, records that it entered active service on 2001-05-18, and estimates availability at about 60%. The count is therefore one in-service carrier on the report date; it does not mean the ship was continuously ready or deployed.

operational_scope: The report states four in-operation boats; it separately says three were in the operational cycle, so this is an inventory count rather than a patrol/readiness count.
source_reference: Norris et al., “French Nuclear Forces, 2001,” vol. 57, issue 4, July 2001, pp. 70–71
source_note: The July 2001 assessment explicitly reports four French SSBNs in operation. Its separate note that three are maintained in the operational cycle does not reduce the four-boat fleet inventory.

operational_scope: Four-boat Vanguard fleet; the source distinguishes fleet inventory from the single boat on patrol.
source_reference: “British Nuclear Forces, 2001,” vol. 57, issue 6, November/December 2001, pp. 78–79
source_note: The contemporary assessment documents the four-boat Vanguard force. HMS Vengeance began its first deterrent patrol in February 2001; one-boat patrol practice does not change the fleet inventory.

operational_scope: The three carriers were in the fleet roster; the Ministry said two were normally available for tasking. This near-year fleet count does not imply readiness in 2001.
source_note: The 2000 parliamentary answer identifies Invincible, Illustrious, and Ark Royal as the Royal Navy's three carriers. It is retained as a moderate-confidence near-year 2001 scenario count; two were normally available for tasking.
